description: Patients none of whose lab records has a U-PRO result of '-'.

a.request: For patients none of whose laboratory records has a urine protein (`U-PRO`) result of '-', first take each patient's average prothrombin time (`PT`) and average alkaline phosphatase-to-ALT ratio (`ALP` ÷ `GPT`, per record) across all their lab records. Then, for each sex (`SEX` from the Patient table, with a blank value as its own group), report the sex and the averages of those per-patient averages. Only lab records with a matching Patient record count. Averages ignore missing values. Don't round.
a.sql:
WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
), per_patient AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS SEX,
       AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_avg_pt,
       AVG(pp.avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_of_patient_avg_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM per_patient AS pp
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = pp.ID
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END;

b.request: For each sex group, including blank SEX as its own group, select patients with no matching lab record where U-PRO = '-'; compute each selected patient’s average PT and average per-record ALP ÷ GPT across their matching lab records, ignoring missing values, then average each measure across patients within the sex group without rounding.
b.sql:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        COALESCE(p.SEX, '') AS sex_group,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 THEN CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT END) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS u
        WHERE u.ID = p.ID AND u.`U-PRO` = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY p.ID, COALESCE(p.SEX, '')
)
SELECT
    sex_group AS SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS average_patient_avg_pt,
    AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS average_patient_avg_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM patient_averages
GROUP BY sex_group;
b.raw: For each sex group, including blank SEX as its own group, select patients with no matching lab record where U-PRO = '-'; compute each selected patient’s average PT and average per-record ALP ÷ GPT across their matching lab records, ignoring missing values, then average each measure across patients within the sex group without rounding.

d.request: Group patients by sex, treating blank SEX as a separate group, and include only patients with matching Patient records who have no Laboratory record with U-PRO = '-'. For each included patient, compute the average non-null PT across their lab records and the average of non-null ALP ÷ GPT ratios per record, excluding records where either value is null or GPT is zero. Then, for each sex group, report the averages of those per-patient figures without rounding.
d.sql:
WITH PerPatient AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS SexGroup,
        AVG(l.PT) AS AvgPT,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 THEN 1.0 * l.ALP / l.GPT END) AS AvgALPtoGPTRatio
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS excluded
        WHERE excluded.ID = p.ID AND excluded.`U-PRO` = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY p.ID, CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END
)
SELECT
    SexGroup AS SEX,
    AVG(AvgPT) AS AvgOfPatientAvgPT,
    AVG(AvgALPtoGPTRatio) AS AvgOfPatientAvgALPtoGPTRatio
FROM PerPatient
GROUP BY SexGroup;

c.request: Looking only at patients without a urine protein (`U-PRO`) result of '-' in their lab tests, what are the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average alkaline phosphatase-to-ALT ratio (`ALP` ÷ `GPT`, per record) by sex? Compute each patient's averages over all their lab records first, then average those per-patient figures within each sex (`SEX` from the Patient table, with a blank value as its own group). Only count lab records that match a Patient record, ignore missing values in the averages and don't round. Patients none of whose lab records has a U-PRO result of '-'.
c.sql:
WITH EligiblePatients AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.`U-PRO` = '-'
    )
), PatientAverages AS (
    SELECT ep.ID, ep.SEX,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
                    THEN 1.0 * l.ALP / l.GPT END) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio
    FROM EligiblePatients ep
    JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = ep.ID
    GROUP BY ep.ID, ep.SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
       AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS average_alp_to_alt_ratio
FROM PatientAverages
GROUP BY SEX;
